item: the data folder's scope question never raises, and an unlistable OOS data folder is erased app-only end to end (R715 follow-ups)
summary: folder_scope answers broad (unlistable) when the question itself raises, such as a path with a NUL byte, instead of raising; the erase already caught that, so this makes the docstring true. A new end-to-end test erases an OOS data folder the scope question cannot list and keeps the operator's file. Release line: none (no behaviour an operator can see changes).
